items.title: Name a pane by typing
items.text: Press Cmd-R, type a name, and the banner's first line becomes the pane's name in the sidebar and on stacked strips. No # heading needed. Bold labels, tables and lists still leave the pane's name alone.

items.title: Cursor on blades
items.text: Moving slowly off a divider onto a blade no longer leaves the resize cursor stuck.
